feat(components): add fuzzy-text component and not-found page
Added a new FuzzyText component that provides a fuzzy text effect, and a new NotFound
that utilizes this component. The FuzzyText component allows for customization of font
weight, family, color, and more, and also supports hover and click effects. The NotFound
page uses this component to display a 404 message with a fuzzy text effect.
